item.title: 🟠 Root RCE Zero-Day in Cisco Secure Email Gateway Under Active Exploitation
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.

An unauthenticated attacker can exploit CVE-2026-76461 to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying OS with root privileges.

The post Root RCE Zero-Day in Cisco Secure Email Gateway Under Active Exploitation appeared first on SecurityWeek.
